note: Separate opt-in AUDIO-TITLE-MENU observation build. Historical reference lock, patch and manifests are unchanged; use reference build --lock tools/locks/audio-observation.json explicitly.

build.notes: local=false avoids -march=native so the library is portable across machines of the same architecture. The upstream default build profile (performance, -O3) is kept. `outputs` lists paths excluded from the patch comparison: build products and the lab-core.json manifest that `reference build` writes into the checkout.

bsnes.patch_diff_command: git add -N -A -- . ':!bsnes/out' ':!bsnes/obj' ':!lab-core.json' && git -c diff.noprefix=false -c diff.mnemonicPrefix=false -c diff.renames=false -c core.abbrev=40 -c diff.algorithm=myers -c diff.suppressBlankEmpty=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --full-index --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/ --no-renames -- . ':!bsnes/out' ':!bsnes/obj' ':!lab-core.json'; git reset -q
